verdict.rationale: Hardware media engines are a fair question for a GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only AI training and inference throughput, memory, networking, power and management for DGX/HGX B300. Nothing covers AV1 or HEVC encode/decode engines, creator-app acceleration, or professional/ISV-certified drivers.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it
